name: 🥪 Open-Faced Pizza & Deli Melts
tagline: Crusty bread, sauce, deli meats and bubbling cheese under the broiler. Dinner in 15.

steps.text: Turn the broiler on high with a rack in the upper third.
Slice the bread in thick slices on an angle (or split the loaf in half the long way).
Brush with olive oil, sprinkle garlic powder, and broil 2 minutes until just crisp.
Everyone builds their own: meats, mozzarella, a pinch of parmesan and Italian seasoning.
Broil 3–4 minutes until the cheese bubbles and browns. Don't walk away.

kid_jobs.job: Make a design with the pepperoni

chef_tip: Toast the bread with oil before the toppings. It keeps the bottom crisp instead of soggy from the sauce.
make_ahead: Nothing to do ahead; it's that fast.
leftovers: Best fresh. Leftover deli meat goes into lunches.
swaps: Brioche loaf or English muffins for little ones
Hoagie dressing + provolone for an Italian-sub version

game_plan.what: Broiler on high. Slice the bread thick.
Oil, garlic powder, broil 2 min until crisp.
Kids set out sauce, meats and cheese.
